summary: The construction and proof are correct for every integer m >= 1, including the smallest case m = 1 and singleton flats. The endpoint-box convex hull has exactly the asserted integer slices, the exhibited differences generate the entire lattice, and the normalized log-affine source has exactly the supported mean (2 times the all-ones vector, 0). The injective coordinate-projection count applies to arbitrary real affine flats; separating constant-height and nonconstant-height flats proves the strict coefficient-one bound in every codimension. The self-varentropy formula and its superlinear dimensional growth, the maximum-atom formula, and both normalized atomic-sum bounds are exact. The substitutions into the supplied entropy-row and capacity definitions preserve the original source and normalization: its own mean row equals the source, its capacity is one, and its canonical likelihood variance is zero. No mathematical error or gap was found.
